_note: Fictional catalog for tests. Titles mirror the kind of requests the data script builds; no BMW data.

requests.title: More real-world electric range
requests.summary: Owners want more usable range, especially in winter and on the motorway.

requests.title: Simpler iDrive menus and touchscreen
requests.summary: Menus are deep and functions are hard to find while driving.

requests.title: More comfortable, better-equipped seats
requests.summary: Seat comfort on long trips, ventilation and massage.

requests.title: Reliable keys and keyless entry
requests.summary: Keys not detected, doors that do not unlock, digital key problems.

requests.title: Better visibility: mirrors, glass and wipers
requests.summary: Wipers, mirrors and glass that limit the view.
